parts.premise: Many schools offer tutoring support during school hours that parents can sign up their kids to attend. After school programs usually set aside time for homework that program counselors oversee. And many teachers offer office hours outside of school time for parents and students. As great as these options are, they don’t work for everyone. Not all kids attend after-school programs, and some students’ schedules are already jam-packed, especially at the high school level.
